title: WASSCE Further Maths: Calculus (Differentiation & Integration) - Further Mathematics - Differentiation (Product Rule)
subject: Further Mathematics

questions.q: Differentiate $y = x^2 \cos x$ with respect to $x$.
questions.explain: Apply the product rule: $u = x^2$, $v = \cos x$. Therefore $u' = 2x$ and $v' = -\sin x$. The rule states $\frac{dy}{dx} = u'v + uv'$, which yields $2x \cos x + x^2 (-\sin x) = 2x \cos x - x^2 \sin x$.
questions.subject: Further Mathematics

questions.q: Differentiate $y = e^x \sin x$ with respect to $x$.
questions.explain: Use the product rule: if $y = uv$, then $\frac{dy}{dx} = u \frac{dv}{dx} + v \frac{du}{dx}$. Let $u = e^x$ and $v = \sin x$. Then $u' = e^x$ and $v' = \cos x$. Substituting these gives $e^x \cos x + e^x \sin x = e^x(\sin x + \cos x)$.
